question: Can a positive footprint-partitioned pixel rule reproduce known covered areas and stabilize the held direct-reflection signal without altering optics?
geometry: Exact unsmoothed ordinary rounded rectangle. Split at footprint/cap joins and crossings of all y partition edges; polar substitution at caps. No source-knot preimage claim.
allowed: Numerical area quadrature only; fixed Gauss orders 8,16,32 for direct signal, 16 for geometry controls.
frozen: All physical surfaces, normals, scene panel48, reference/cases/inputs/AA2 records; no target-dependent selection.
selection: Six declared boundary pixels per member, upper/lower straight-body extrema nearest native row plus/minus one; no target read.
stop: First area/positivity/membership/mirror failure or cap/deadline; no silent rule repair. Original AA2 remains unchanged.
